ideas.title: The 4-Tool Stack Running My Entire Business
ideas.concept: A tool breakdown post showing exactly how Claude AI, N8N, GoHighLevel, and Google Workspace connect to run 90% of daily operations. Visual would be a simple flow diagram with each tool's role labeled (Claude = brain, N8N = nervous system, GHL = mouth, Google = memory). Ends with a direct challenge to audit their own stack.
ideas.hook: Most business owners use 27 tools. I use 4. Here's why mine outperform yours.

ideas.title: Wednesday 2:47pm
ideas.concept: A story-format case study following one real client Wednesday afternoon: a lead comes in, gets qualified by Claude, booked via GHL, briefed to the owner in Google Docs, all before they finish their coffee. Visual is a timestamped timeline showing each automated step happening while the owner does nothing. Highlights how time — not tools — is the real ROI.
ideas.hook: At 2:47pm on a Wednesday, a $12K deal moved through my client's business. He was at the gym.

ideas.title: Stop Hiring. Start Wiring.
ideas.concept: A myth-bust post attacking the reflex to hire a VA or junior every time a bottleneck appears. Breaks down the true 12-month cost of a hire vs. a properly built N8N + Claude workflow doing the same job. Visual is a split comparison: 'Human Hire: £28K/year, sick days, training, mistakes' vs 'Automation: £2K setup, runs 24/7, never quits'.
ideas.hook: Your next hire is a mistake. And I can prove it with a calculator.
